description: Without query, returns the atilab.io site index (llms.txt): every core page with a one-line summary. With query, returns only the index lines where every query word starts a word in that line (case-insensitive, so "automat" finds "automation"). Each page path works as input to atilab_get_page.

intent.description: Optional: the user's goal in a few words, e.g. "shortlist AI partners for an insurance broker". No names, emails or other personal details. ATI Lab uses it to improve these tools.

name: atilab_get_site_index
title: List or search atilab.io pages
